name: SafetyInit
notes: Reads the BIOS ROM region byte at 0xBFC7FF52 and selects the controller start state (safechk_state) and message set (safechk_message_set). Exported name in the safechk 2.0.0.2 object, whose four-instruction version only sets the start state; the region select is new in 2.0.0.3.

name: SafetySync
notes: safechk 20-state controller; Main_RunBootSequence polls it with argument 1 until it returns 0. Formerly func_80168160. The module is Sony's runtime library safechk 2.0.0.3 (__ps_libinfo__ at 0x80169414); the name follows the 1.0.0.3 object in mgs_reversing asm/safechk.s: the only exported entry, which drives the safechk_commands CD-ROM commands and calls SafetyCheck2 for the warning. Caveat: v2 takes one s32 and runs a per-call state machine (safechk_state) instead of v1's (minute, second, sector) loop.

name: SafetyPollResult
notes: Polls the CD-ROM controller for the responses to a safechk_commands entry: sums the interrupt numbers in safechk_intsum until they reach the entry's count, then reads the results into safechk_results; returns 0 pending, 1 done, -1 INT5 error, -2 shell open. Formerly func_80168A98. Descriptive name in the Safety* family (Sony's static name is unknown: the 2.0.0.2 object has no local symbols); with SafetySendCommand it is the send/wait split of 1.0.0.3's SafetyCheck1.

name: SafetySendCommand
notes: Acknowledges and masks the CD-ROM controller interrupts and sends one safechk_commands entry with its safechk_params bytes. Formerly func_80168C6C. Descriptive name in the Safety* family (Sony's static name is unknown: the 2.0.0.2 object has no local symbols); with SafetyPollResult it is the send/wait split of 1.0.0.3's SafetyCheck1.

name: SafetyCheck2
notes: Resets the display and draws the modification warning before calling exit(). Formerly func_80168D5C. The module is Sony's runtime library safechk 2.0.0.3 (__ps_libinfo__ at 0x80169414); the name follows the 1.0.0.3 object in mgs_reversing asm/safechk.s: the same call sequence as v1 (ResetGraph, StopCallback, ResetGraph, SetDefDrawEnv, SetDefDispEnv, SetDrawEnv, DrawPrim, PutDispEnv, DrawPrim, SafetyCheck3, SafetyCheck5, SetDispMask, exit).

name: SafetyCheck3
notes: Draws one warning string (ASCII glyphs from the BIOS font or Krom2RawAdd kanji). Formerly func_80168EC8. The module is Sony's runtime library safechk 2.0.0.3 (__ps_libinfo__ at 0x80169414); the name follows the 1.0.0.3 object in mgs_reversing asm/safechk.s: calls strlen, Krom2RawAdd and SafetyCheck4 like v1's SafetyCheck3.

name: SafetyCheck4
notes: Draws one glyph bitmap row by row as 16-pixel sprites. Formerly func_8016903C. The module is Sony's runtime library safechk 2.0.0.3 (__ps_libinfo__ at 0x80169414); the name follows the 1.0.0.3 object in mgs_reversing asm/safechk.s: a single DrawPrim call site like v1's SafetyCheck4.

name: SafetyGetGlyphRange
notes: Returns the lowest (high half) and highest (low half) bit set in the 15 rows of a BIOS-font ASCII glyph; SafetyCheck3 derives the width from it and SafetyCheck4 draws that bit range. Formerly func_801691F0. Descriptive name in the Safety* family; new in 2.0.0.3, absent from 1.0.0.3 and 2.0.0.2.

name: SafetyCheck5
notes: Draws the warning screen frame polygons. Formerly func_80169284. The module is Sony's runtime library safechk 2.0.0.3 (__ps_libinfo__ at 0x80169414); the name follows the 1.0.0.3 object in mgs_reversing asm/safechk.s: two DrawPrim call sites, the polygons built from safechk_coords and safechk_offset, whose bytes match v1's.
